judge.voice: Víte, I liked Mia. She speaks slowly, one question, no sighing, and she talks about school and tomatoes, which is my Sunday. The first help, "How is school today?", was exactly what I needed. But then the phrase choices offered "I have a red car", which is no use to me, and the buttons went round and round. The correction "Is school good?" I understood, and I could say it. At the end it said "Mission done" while Mia was still asking "Are they red?" I wanted to answer! And I did not try the replay, so I do not know if I would do better. I trust the corrections; they used my own words. I would come on Saturday again, but the help must be about my grandchildren, not red cars. I would tell my friend from the library, carefully.
